capabilities: detect pasted URLs in the editor
fetch the page title from the URL
insert a Markdown link with the fetched title
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide autolinker that rewrites existing bare URLs; it only converts URLs at the moment you paste them.
extras: The manifest carries the unreleased-plugin warning: 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The README names the plugin 'Linkify' while the plugin id is auto-linkify.
problem: Pasting a URL into the editor leaves bare links instead of Markdown links with readable page titles, which the user would otherwise have to fetch and write manually.
summary: Paste-time URL formatter that converts a pasted URL into a Markdown link using the page's fetched title.
